desc: Derive and document the cost identity: answer = sum(U_i+D_i) - N·H, where H is the final common upper+lower sum.
Implement O(N) H_max = min_{i,j}(D_i + U_j + X·|i-j|) via split at i: min( D_i + min_{j<=i}(U_j - X·j) + X·i, D_i + min_{j>=i}(U_j + X·j) - X·i ).
Print S - N·H_max as a 64-bit integer and test all provided samples.
Validate with a small-N brute force over feasible final lengths for random tests, especially H=0, large X, N=2, and large sums.
(Fallback) Binary search on H with interval propagation noted; unnecessary given closed form passes all samples.
